title: Build github.com/ceffo/toast — BubbleTea v2 toast notification library
description:
A new Go library (not a fork) providing animated toast-style notifications overlaid on BubbleTea v2 TUI apps.

Key decisions:
- lipgloss v2 NewCompositor for overlay — no hand-rolled ANSI surgery
- Render(content string) string API — alert always topmost layer
- Model does NOT implement tea.Model — Update returns concrete (Model, tea.Cmd)
- FIFO alert queue, configurable depth, evict-oldest on overflow
- AlertDefinition passed directly to NewAlertCmd — no string key registry
- Lab-space lerp animation via go-colorful (~600ms fade-in)
- Render-time terminal size clamping — no resize state on Model

See docs/adr/ and CONTEXT.md for full rationale.

title: US-002: definition.go — FontStyle, AlertDefinition, built-in alert vars
description:
Implement the FontStyle enum, AlertDefinition struct, and built-in package-level alert vars.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `type FontStyle` enum with FontASCII, FontUnicode, FontNerdFont constants
- [ ] `AlertDefinition` struct with fields: Prefix string, ForeColor string, Position Position (optional — zero means use model default)
- [ ] Built-in vars for each FontStyle: InfoAlert, WarnAlert, ErrorAlert, DebugAlert (12 vars total — 4 types × 3 font styles, or a constructor function per type that takes FontStyle)
- [ ] Built-in colors: Info=#00FF00, Warn=#FFFF00, Error=#FF0000, Debug=#FF00FF
- [ ] NerdFont prefixes:  (info), 󱈸 (warn), 󰬅 (error), 󰃤 (debug)
- [ ] Unicode prefixes: ⓘ (info), ⚠ (warn), ✘ (error), ? (debug)
- [ ] ASCII prefixes: (i), (!), [!!], (?)
- [ ] `go build ./...` passes
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes

title: US-003: wrap.go — hangingWrap text helper
description:
Implement the hangingWrap helper that wraps alert message text with a hanging indent for the prefix symbol.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `hangingWrap(prefix, msg string, textWidth int) string` function
- [ ] First line: prefix + space + start of message
- [ ] Subsequent lines: indented by len(prefix)+1 spaces so message aligns under first line
- [ ] Uses charm.land/lipgloss/v2 Width() for prefix measurement (handles Unicode/NerdFont widths)
- [ ] Word-wraps at textWidth, does not break mid-word unless word longer than available width
- [ ] Degenerate case (textWidth too small): returns prefix + msg unsplit
- [ ] `go build ./...` passes
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes

title: US-004: alert.go — internal alert struct and render() using lipgloss v2
description:
Implement the internal alert struct (one live notification instance) and its render() method using lipgloss v2.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unexported `alert` struct with fields: message, deathTime, prefix, foreColor (colorful.Color), style, width, minWidth, curLerpStep float64, position Position
- [ ] `render() string` method that:
  - [ ] Lerps border/text color from black to foreColor using Lab-space interpolation (go-colorful BlendLab)
  - [ ] Clamps actual width between minWidth and maxWidth based on rendered message length (dynamic width mode when minWidth > 0)
  - [ ] Uses lipgloss RoundedBorder, Foreground, BorderForeground, Width, Padding(0,1)
  - [ ] Calls hangingWrap for message content
- [ ] `go build ./...` passes
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes

title: US-005: model.go — Model struct, constructor, With* builders, Init/Update/Render/HasActiveAlert
description:
Implement the public Model and all its methods. This is the main library surface.

## Acceptance Criteria

### Struct & constructor
- [ ] `Model` struct with: queue []alert, maxDepth int, width int, minWidth int, duration time.Duration, position Position, allowEscToClose bool
- [ ] `New(width int, font FontStyle, duration time.Duration) Model` constructor
- [ ] `WithMinWidth(min int) Model`
- [ ] `WithPosition(pos Position) Model`
- [ ] `WithQueueDepth(depth int) Model`
- [ ] `WithAllowEscToClose() Model`

### tea integration (NOT implementing tea.Model)
- [ ] `Init() tea.Cmd` returns nil
- [ ] `Update(msg tea.Msg) (Model, tea.Cmd)` handles:
  - [ ] `alertMsg` — push to queue, evict oldest if at maxDepth, start tick if queue was empty
  - [ ] `tickMsg` — advance curLerpStep on head alert, pop head if deathTime passed, stop tick if queue empty
  - [ ] `tea.KeyPressMsg` with "esc" — clears head alert if allowEscToClose
- [ ] `HasActiveAlert() bool` — returns len(queue) > 0

### NewAlertCmd
- [ ] `NewAlertCmd(def AlertDefinition, msg string) tea.Cmd` — creates alertMsg, uses def.Position if set else model position

### Render
- [ ] `Render(content string) string`:
  - [ ] Returns content unchanged if queue empty
  - [ ] Renders head alert via alert.render()
  - [ ] Clamps alert width to min(configuredMaxWidth, lip.Width(content)) at call time
  - [ ] Computes (x, y) from lip.Width/Height(content) and position
  - [ ] Uses lip.NewCompositor with bg layer + alert layer at computed (x,y)

### Position coordinate calculation
- [ ] TopLeft: x=0, y=0
- [ ] TopCenter: x=(contentW-alertW)/2, y=0
- [ ] TopRight: x=contentW-alertW, y=0
- [ ] BottomLeft: x=0, y=contentH-alertH
- [ ] BottomCenter: x=(contentW-alertW)/2, y=contentH-alertH
- [ ] BottomRight: x=contentW-alertW, y=contentH-alertH
- [ ] All coordinates clamped to >= 0

### Quality gates
- [ ] `go build ./...` passes
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes

title: US-006: example/main.go — working example app demonstrating all features
description:
Implement a runnable example app that demonstrates all public features of the toast library.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Separate Go module or build tag so it does not affect library go.mod
- [ ] Uses charm.land/bubbletea/v2 — View() returns tea.View with v.AltScreen = true
- [ ] Embeds toast.Model, calls Init(), Update(), Render() correctly
- [ ] No type assertions (Update returns concrete toast.Model directly)
- [ ] Demonstrates all 6 positions (key bindings to trigger each)
- [ ] Demonstrates all 4 built-in alert types (Info, Warn, Error, Debug)
- [ ] Demonstrates dynamic width (WithMinWidth)
- [ ] Demonstrates WithAllowEscToClose + HasActiveAlert ESC guard pattern
- [ ] Demonstrates WithQueueDepth — fires multiple alerts in burst to show queue
- [ ] Demonstrates a custom AlertDefinition (user-defined type)
- [ ] App compiles and runs: `go run ./example`
- [ ] `go build ./...` passes
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes
